typeProperties.script:
source(output(
		MemberID as string,
		AuthID as string,
		AuthStatus as string,
		ProviderID as string,
		UrgentIndicator as string,
		AUTHTYPE as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> FlatFileSource
FlatFileSource derive(MemberID = MemberID) ~> PlaceHolderRowCount
PlaceHolderRowCount split(length(MemberID) > 11, disjoint: true) ~> CheckFieldLengths@(FieldTooLong,ConditionalSplitDefaultOutput)
CheckFieldLengths@ConditionalSplitDefaultOutput derive(FileIID = $File_IID,
		CreateDate = currentTimestamp(),
		Market_CD = toString($MarketID),
		MemberID = MemberID + '00') ~> AddFileIdandMemberNumber
AddFileIdandMemberNumber derive(FileIID = FileIID) ~> PlaceHolderRecordsImportedCount
PlaceHolderRecordsImportedCount sink(input(
		UMPreCert_AuthID as string,
		UMPreCert_CREATE_DATE as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		URGENT as string,
		UMPreCert_AUTH_STATUS as string,
		UMPreCert_PROVIDERID as string,
		UMPreCert_AUTH_TYPE as string,
		UMPreCert_MEMBERNUMBER as string,
		FILEIMPORT_IID as integer,
		UMPreCert_MARKET_CD as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	stagingSchemaName: 'dbo',
	saveOrder: 10000,
	insertable:true,
	deletable:false,
	upsertable:false,
	updateable:false,
	keys:[],
	mapColumn(
		UMPreCert_AuthID = AuthID,
		UMPreCert_CREATE_DATE = CreateDate,
		URGENT = UrgentIndicator,
		UMPreCert_AUTH_STATUS = AuthStatus,
		UMPreCert_PROVIDERID = ProviderID,
		UMPreCert_AUTH_TYPE = AUTHTYPE,
		UMPreCert_MEMBERNUMBER = MemberID,
		FILEIMPORT_IID = FileIID,
		UMPreCert_MARKET_CD = Market_CD)) ~> PDSUMPreCertInbound
